items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Benny Goodman. This was all in '26...

ctx.x: Did you own a record player at that time?
Yeah, we had plenty of records. Red Nichols. Frankie Trumbauer. Bix. Benny Goodman. This was all in '26...
I know some of those records, like "Singing The Blues," that didn't come out until '27, I think.
